description.name: Entry
description.text:
Tactical Awoken Mode, +500 MAG & +500 MND to user
Tactical Awoken Mode: Dark/Holy Ability Boost, Triplecast Dark/Holy, Unlimited Dark/Holy Hones, Cap Break Level 1 to Dark/Holy Abilities, Dark/Holy Ability Damage +30% & ATB Speed x1.1 to Dark/Holy Abilities; Ends after using 8 Dark/Holy abilities
TP Max: AOE Dark/NE or Holy/NE hybrid attack at True Cap Break Level 1 under En-Dark or En-Holy

description.name: War-Awoken Void Zenith (Weapon Skill)
description.text:
Single-target Dark/Holy/NE piercing hybrid attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & ATB Speed x1.2 to Dark/Holy Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold with at least Lv.0/2 En-Dark/Holy
WS Blue: Lv.2 En-Dark/Holy Stack to user
WS Gold: Surging Power 30% for 6 turns to all allies
